issues.on_page: Government-wide Statement of Net Position with receivables, capital assets, accumulated depreciation and bonds payable; proprietary depreciation (pp1-2, 13-14)
issues.issue: Basis recorded as cash to match FY2023-FY2025 (the extractor's own assumption, stated in notes), but the statements are GAAP/accrual-style. A person should confirm the basis.
The Statement of Activities prints governmental net position, but it was left null because basis was recorded as cash. If the report is treated as GAAP, these values belong here.

issues.on_page: Cash and Equivalents 823,447; Restricted cash 268,423; Due from County Treasurer 5,056 (no printed cash total)
issues.issue: Ending cash is a computed sum of two printed lines. The 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is never derived. Also, Due from County Treasurer 5,056 is classed as Cash and Cash Equivalents in balance_sheet but left out of this sum. The arithmetic itself is correct.

issues.on_page: ARPA Grant Income 115,927 + Grant income - Library 5,650 (under Other Financing Sources (Uses))
issues.issue: These federal/library grant receipts are recorded as other_financing, as printed, so they are not in receipts. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows them as operating grants. Defensible under the as-printed rule; flagged so a person can confirm.

Category is an assumption (public power district 5% gross revenue in-lieu tax). The page does not say who pays it. Same assumption in detail rows for General Fund 7,205 (p6) and Debt Service 4,891 (p12).

In a utility's operating expenses, 'Schools' is likely operator training (the detail rows already use detail_category dues, training and travel). Category School-Related Spending applies the city school-label rule. Judgment call; same for the Water p15 and Sewer p16 detail rows.

issues.on_page: Lagoon farm expense 28,406; Locations 278; Lagoon discharge 331
issues.issue: Utility cost-type lines put in 'other' (with review notes). 'Locations' (utility locates) and 'Lagoon discharge' could be professional/contract services. The cost type is not printed, so this is a defensible judgment call (also disbursements[21], disbursements[27] and matching detail rows).
